title: Satisfaction Trial Terms — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Satisfaction trial — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** A customer who is not satisfied with the ride of a new set may return it within the satisfaction trial.

| Condition | Basis |
|---|---|
| Set status | must be active when a trial return is completed |
| Trial period | the return must be completed no later than the end of the trial period counted from the installation of the set; calendar days are counted from the day after the anchor date, so the anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date; the period is the line's trial days |
| Trial miles | the miles driven since installation, read at the store when the tires come off, must not exceed the line's trial miles |
| Returns per vehicle | the trial returns already made on the vehicle, over every tire set ever bought for it, must be below the line's trial returns per vehicle; a vehicle that has already used its trial return gets none on a later set |
| Remedy | where the line offers exchange only, the money is returned as store credit toward another Crestline tire line; otherwise the customer chooses refund or exchange |

**Clauses no longer in force as first issued.**
- "A set with any treadwear adjustment or workmanship replacement is past the trial" is no longer in force in that form; it is superseded by the current trial-refund basis.
- "The return is the customer's own decision about their tires: the agent registers the request and the customer confirms it, and only the confirmation returns the set" is no longer in force as a rule for every return; it holds for every return request other than the trial refund the customer confirms in person.
- "The amount returned is the tire count times the price per tire, less any set instant savings the ticket received, plus the mounting, valve-stem or TPMS-kit charges per tire when the line returns installation charges with the tires; disposal fees and any rotation charges are never returned" is no longer in force as a rule for every trial return; it holds on every trial return other than the trial refund the customer confirms in person, whose refund on the set's ticket is the tire price paid, plus every part its own terms return and less every charge they take, each worked out on its own. Disposal fees and any rotation charges are never returned on any trial return.

**Trial period, both sides (hypothetical 30-day line, installed on day 0):** a return completed on day 30 is inside the trial; on day 31 it is not.

superseded_clauses: A set with any treadwear adjustment or workmanship replacement is past the trial.
The return is the customer's own decision about their tires: the agent registers the request and the customer confirms it, and only the confirmation returns the set.

The amount returned is tire_count times unit_price, less any set_instant_savings the ticket received, plus the mounting, valve-stem or TPMS-kit charges per tire when satisfaction_refund_includes_installation is true; disposal fees and any rotation charges are never returned.
